# Sgn <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Sgn(value)
```

## Description

The sign of a number: -1 for a number below 0, 0 for 0 and 1 for a number above 0, as an integer or a float like the number.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print Sgn(-12)
Print Sgn(0)
Print Sgn(0.5)
```

```text
-1
0
1.0
```
